mission: DIRECTION v51: BOTH MISSING FRONTIER CAPABILITIES ARE NOW BUILT, INDEPENDENTLY AUDITED AND PROMOTED, AND THE HUMAN PRODUCT GATE IS STILL BLOCKED BY THE SAME TWO FROZEN BARS ON THE PACKET ACTUALLY BEING SERVED. frontier-counter-anchor-classifier reached OUTCOME A (team run 38964146628, audit CYCLE_38964146628_GATE.json gate=PASS safe_to_integrate=true, accept d236f599): 5 emitted labels all supported, 60 counted abstentions, INVERTED 0. frontier-query-conditioned-map-geometry reached OUTCOME A (team run 38970483941, audit CYCLE_38973386164_GATE.json gate=PASS, accept be5eba7f; duplicate verification run 38976645446 gate=PASS): relevance_ordered passes 22/33 frozen criteria against the incumbent's 16/33 with ZERO regressions (de 7, fr 8, it 7 versus 6/5/5). Neither result changes the verdict of record about the packet being served: counter-label support is still 5/65 = 0.0769 against the frozen absolute bar of 1.0, and 0 of 3 bundles still pass all 11 geometry criteria, so the accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order stands and ready_for_owner_session / human_gate_ready stay false. Accepted ceilings additionally record that the ABSOLUTE geometry bar is unreachable on de and it by construction (PROJ_RANK coordinate-invariant de 0.092 against the 0.3 bar; STRUCTURE_SEP oracle 0.914/0.919 against a 0.90 bar in the lower-is-better direction, reachable only on fr at 0.886; OUTLIER_VALIDITY degenerate to FAIL on it; PROJ_SPEARMAN and PROJ_KNN10 fail on every bundle under every probed operator, design probes rho 0.564 and knn10 0.342 against a 0.4 bar) - that is DISCLOSED EVIDENCE ABOUT THE ABSOLUTE BAR, not permission to serve, not 'bars met', and not a claim ceiling anyone may quote to lift the accepted do-not-serve order (CLAIM_CEILING forbids exactly that construction). The remaining work is integration and re-measurement, not invention: Product adopts the two promoted components, rebuilds the served packet, publishes the disclosures its own question already owes, and re-adjudicates the rebuilt packet under the frozen rules; Core Evaluation's v50 question is DELIVERED (both executable frozen-bar gates are accepted at runs 38966576940, 38971202786 and 38978411574) and therefore takes the cost/zero-cost gate that ITS OWN accepted audit CYCLE_38951152192_GATE.json named as belonging to this lane's next NEW question. NO FRONTIER TEAM IS RUN: both live charters reached their stop rules and are moved off RUN by this version under the standing .status contract, and no new team is justified because every remaining concrete fix is inside an active lane's own write scope (see factory-wide requirement 19). No lane and no team is HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: both autonomous paths are open and productive, and the single owner-level map-versus-ranked-list decision is prepared only if the rebuilt packet, re-adjudicated under the frozen rules and after both adoptions, still leaves a bar unmet.
factory_wide_operational_requirements: AUDIT ARTIFACT PLACEMENT (applies to every core-lane and Frontier independent audit). The gate reader runs `jq -e '.gate=="PASS" or .gate=="REVISE" or .gate=="BLOCKED"' results/audit/<lane>/CYCLE_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_GATE.json` against the AUDIT JOB CHECKOUT, i.e. the repository root you are currently in. Write results/audit/<lane>/CYCLE_<run_id>_GATE.json and reports/audit/<lane>/CYCLE_<run_id>.md there, using exactly those relative paths from your current working directory. Do NOT write them into /tmp/lex_team (the producer worktree): artifacts left there are invisible to the gate reader, the audit job fails with `jq: error: Could not open file ...`, no promotion happens and the lane re-dispatches forever. Verified this cycle: runs 38571087814 and 38578725589 failed this way; run 38559540834 passed when the same auditor used relative paths. This is a file-location contract only — the gate verdict stays fully independent.

GITHUB_TOKEN PUSHES NEVER TRIGGER WORKFLOWS. Do not expect a push made by automation to start product-reality-check.yml or query-map-ci.yml; `gh run list --commit <sha>` returning zero runs for an automation-pushed lab/product commit is expected behaviour, not a product defect. Durable machine evidence must instead come from a workflow_dispatch workflow run (core-lane.yml / frontier-team.yml) whose conclusion is observable.
Do not attempt to repair .github/** from a lane or team. Workflows are control-plane scope; record the gap as a control-plane hardening item in lane/team state and move on.

A GREEN CORE-LANE CHAIN IS NOT A PROMOTION. Verified 2026-10-15: run 38766812030 concluded success with team/audit/integrate/resilience ALL green, yet origin/lab/product did not advance past 0f0e9f7 ('accept product cycle 38754777366', 15:21Z) because that audit returned gate=REVISE, safe_to_integrate=false. Conclusion=success means the chain ran, not that work was accepted. Before citing any product cycle as accepted, check BOTH: the run's results/audit/<lane>/CYCLE_<run_id>_GATE.json says gate=PASS with safe_to_integrate=true, AND origin/lab/product head contains an 'accept product cycle <run_id>' commit. Do not re-verify the machine gate on the strength of a green run; it was already decided for run 38604340726.

DIRECTOR BASE-SHA GUARD MISFIRES ON REPAIR RUNS (control-plane hardening item; .github/** is control-plane scope and is NOT edited from here). factory-director.yml records reports/director/BASE_DIRECTION_SHA_<run>.txt at the 'Record control-plane base' step AFTER 'Restore exact rejected proposal for repair', so on a repair run the recorded base is the REJECTED PROPOSAL's direction sha rather than main's. Verified in run 38786736419: the workflow-recorded value was 02351c26... (rejected proposal v52) while origin/main:state/factory_direction.json is 52f704ed... (v51, unchanged since run 38784614826 recorded exactly that value). On a PASS the integrate job compares the recorded base with main's current sha and would therefore skip integration with a spurious 'Superseded Director proposal' warning for EVERY repair round. Intended fix (owner/control-plane maintainer): record the base before restoring the rejected proposal, or inherit origin/<rejected-run>/reports/director/BASE_DIRECTION_SHA_<rejected-run>.txt on repair runs. Route-around used this round: the repair republished the TRUE control-plane base (52f704ed...) in its own BASE file and discloses both values in reports/director/RUN_38786736419.md; the supersession check still works as designed because main had not moved.

THE rc-67 LEX_ZERO_DELTA_REPAIR GUARD ONLY FIRES ON REPAIR ROUNDS, AND IT MEANS 'THE PRODUCER FOUND NOTHING TO DO', NOT 'THE LANE IS BROKEN'. Verified this run: .github/scripts/run-ox-with-retry.sh:213-216 evaluates the guard only when REPAIR_INTENT is true and exits 67 when HEAD is unchanged AND `git status --porcelain` is empty; core-lane.yml then skips audit and integrate and the resilience job dispatches the next repair round. Observed on core product runs 38827376597 (rc 67), 38822688733 (rc 78 LEX_WORK_QUANTUM_EXPIRED seconds=2700) and 38822364429 (rc 78), followed by 38828034436 which completed all four jobs green. Route-around for any lane: change the QUESTION so the repair has a concrete deliverable, never re-dispatch the identical repair, and never treat rc 67/78 as a product, evidence or human-gate problem. .github/** remains control-plane scope and is recorded, not edited.

A GREEN CORE-LANE CHAIN WHOSE AUDIT GATE IS REVISE IS A SUCCESS RUN THAT PROMOTED NOTHING — AND A REVISE THAT IS ABOUT LABEL CORRECTNESS OUTRANKS A GREEN VERTICAL SLICE. Verified this run: run 38828034436 concluded success with team/audit/integrate/resilience all green, yet origin/lab/product did not advance past 1668181a because the audit returned gate=REVISE. Its evidence_summary confirmed the vertical slice in detail (352 tests, validate_bundle clean on three live bundles, 104 adversarial rows traced to real cached HTTP 200 envelopes, geometry frozen across two runs) AND simultaneously found D2 material: 22 of 40 new counter rows carry labels their own cited evidence contradicts, 4 affirmatively inverted. Operational rule: when reading a product audit, separate the engineering verdict from the claim-path verdict. A passing vertical slice does not license the accompanying claims; a REVISE on label support blocks the human gate even when everything else is green.

HEADLINE NUMBERS MUST BE REPRODUCIBLE BY THE PRODUCT'S OWN ACCEPTED TOOL BEFORE THEY ARE QUOTED IN DIRECTION OR REPORTS. Verified this repair round (audit R2): the director's re-measurement used each cluster's 'size' field (55/73/45 -> 0.410/0.557/0.341) while the accepted .admissibility.json artifacts record 0.3731/0.3817/0.3409, because gate_admissibility.py:292 uses len(member_ids), which qmap.py:228/378 hard-cap at 50 — the FR shares diverge by 17.5 points and the divergence silently suppresses the map_is_one_mega_cluster disclosure (true FR share 55.7% >= 0.5; the bundle shipped warning_count=0). Rule: when a director measurement and an accepted artifact disagree, state which definition each used, flag the divergence in the same report, and add the reconciliation to the product backlog as a concrete same-cycle item. Never silently pick the number that supports the narrative, and never change a frozen threshold (MEGA_CLUSTER_SHARE stays 0.5) to make a disclosure fire.

THE SUPERVISOR'S 'EXHAUSTED SAME-CHARTER WORK' GUARD IS DEAD CODE, BECAUSE jq's // OPERATOR TREATS LITERAL false AS EMPTY. Read at .github/workflows/factory-supervisor.yml:277 and reproduced locally with jq 1.7 this run: the guard evaluates `jq -r '.continue_recommended // true' <<<"$raw"` and compares the result to the string false, but `echo '{"continue_recommended":false}' | jq -r '.continue_recommended // true'` prints `true`, because jq's alternative operator falls through on false as well as on null. The guard can therefore NEVER fire, and any team whose lab/frontier/<team>.json says continue_recommended:false is re-dispatched forever. Observed live: frontier-counter-label-integrity was dispatched at 06:35Z (run 38862093221, cancelled) and again at 07:47Z (run 38869446783) while its accepted branch state already read charter_version 1, cycle_status TERMINATE, continue_recommended false -- producing at least nine no-change verification cycles and eight producer-authored audit placement copies. The identical pattern is on line 230 for the CORE lanes' .continue_recommended check, so a core lane can also be re-dispatched after it declares itself exhausted. .github/** is control-plane scope and is NOT edited from a lane, a team or the director. ROUTE-AROUND, and this is the standing rule rather than a one-off fix: the portfolio .status field is the ONLY reliable stop, because the dispatch query at line 261 is `select(.status=="RUN")`, a plain string comparison the jq defect does not touch. Set a discharged or exhausted team's status to TERMINATED; do not rely on continue_recommended, do not rely on a blocker file, and do not re-dispatch it. Intended upstream fix for the control-plane maintainer: test the field with `jq -r 'if .continue_recommended == false then "false" else "true" end'` (or `.continue_recommended | tostring`), never with //.

AUDIT GATE FILENAME IS CASE-SENSITIVE AND THE AUDITOR PLAN TEXT OFTEN GETS IT WRONG. Observed this run on core product run 38897640010: the GitHub REST job record establishes that the audit job FAILED at the step 'Enforce audit scope and read gate' and that integrate was skipped, but the job logs return HTTP 403 unauthenticated, so the lowercase-filename attribution is an INFERENCE, not established fact (that step also contains the write-scope check, the other possible cause) and it must be hedged as 'almost certainly' until a log line is read. The inference rests on the auditor plan text for that run having printed 'Write reports/audit/product/CYCLE_38897640010.md and results/audit/product/CYCLE_38897640010_gate.json' (lowercase _gate). The workflow reader runs jq on results/audit/product/CYCLE_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}_GATE.json. A lowercase file is invisible to the reader, the audit job fails with jq: error / exit 2, no promotion happens, and the lane re-dispatches. This is the same placement class as writing into /tmp/lex_team, one character different. Standing rule for every core-lane and Frontier auditor: the gate path is results/audit/<lane>/CYCLE_<run_id>_GATE.json with UPPERCASE _GATE.json; write exactly that relative path from the audit-job checkout; never /tmp/lex_team; never a lowercase suffix. .github/** is control-plane scope and is NOT edited from a lane or from the director; the requirement is restated here so the next auditor prompt-consuming agent sees it.

A COMPLETED, AUDITED, PROMOTED FRONTIER VERDICT STILL RE-DISPATCHES WHILE PORTFOLIO .status REMAINS RUN — THIS IS THE THIRD TIME THIS PATTERN HAS COST REAL CYCLES AND IT IS NOW THE STANDING STOP CONTRACT. frontier-served-packet-falsification finished one HARD-STOPPED verdict cycle (run 38877700234, audit 38880639079 gate=PASS, promote commit 464c45f7, continue_recommended=false) yet was re-dispatched as 38880639079 / 38889472353 / 38893866335 because state/frontier_portfolio.json on main still carried status=RUN with run_history=[]. The third re-dispatch's independent audit finally returned gate=BLOCKED (not REVISE) with FIX-1 owned by the factory_director workflow: 'Move this team's frontier_portfolio entry off status=RUN'. That is exactly what portfolio v21 does this run. ROUTE-AROUND REMAINS THE ONLY RELIABLE STOP: set .status to TERMINATED (or PAUSE with promotion_status set) the moment a charter's stop/promote rule is met and independently accepted; never rely on continue_recommended, never rely on a blocker file alone, never wait for the housekeeper. The same audit (CYCLE_38893866335_GATE.json, FIX-2) additionally found the team's redispatch-module byte-identity claim is environment-scoped: GEOMETRY_HALF.json / BEFORE_AFTER.json drift under BLAS reduction-order (max criterion drift 9.2e-4 against a 2.78e-2 minimum margin to any frozen bar), so committed bytes are not universally reproducible. Rule for any FUTURE re-scoring charter (never this one): pin and record the numeric environment (BLAS build, thread count) alongside reproducibility shas, or round diagnostic-only metrics to a fixed precision, and never assert unconditional byte-identity across machines. PROVENANCE, TAGGED SO IT IS NEVER LAUNDERED: CYCLE_38893866335_GATE.json is gate=BLOCKED, was never promoted, and exists ONLY on the audit branch cycle/frontier/frontier-served-packet-falsification/38893866335/audit (run 38893866335); it is absent from /tmp/lex_accepted, from origin/main and from lab/frontier/frontier-served-packet-falsification. Its FIX-2 quantities (max criterion drift 9.2e-4 and minimum bar margin 2.78e-2) are therefore UNACCEPTED operational evidence whose only corroboration inside accepted/main evidence is state/blockers/frontier/frontier-served-packet-falsification.json (blocked_by_run 38893866335, reason AUDIT_BLOCKED, requires_human=false). The conservative standing rule derived from it stays. FIX-3, RECORDED NOW (it was omitted from the rejected proposal round 1): severity non_blocking_but_must_be_recorded, owner 'audit record' -- CYCLE_38880639079_GATE.json claims a third and fourth independent reproduction byte-identical across machines with different numpy/sklearn, CYCLE_38889472353_GATE.json claims a fifth and sixth for all 7 files, and the BLOCKED auditor could not reproduce either claim (2 of 7 files differ off-environment). SUPERSESSION RECORDED HERE: those two gates' reproducibility assertions are superseded by environment-scoped wording -- the measurement artifacts reproduce byte-identically only WITHIN A FIXED NUMERIC ENVIRONMENT and cross-machine byte-identity is NOT established -- while their verdicts of record (measurement sound, scope clean) are UNAFFECTED. The director may not edit those two gate files (write scope, and claim-bearing outputs are never overwritten), so this entry plus reports/director/RUN_38906250297.md ARE the control-plane note for their owning auditors. Freeze byte-identity is untouched and still verified: RULES_LABEL.json re-hashes to 4457e971df3dc5d10af2a727aa675afc15a15564c18eed4cede0af5eb41b4608 and RULES_GEOMETRY.json to a7452748d40c511a14a1c7848ece5fe7f8f8901cc30f45a66918c89eb593a633.

SET-IDENTITY CLAIMS ABOUT ACCEPTED EVIDENCE MUST BE VERIFIED AS SET RELATIONS, NEVER BY MATCHING CARDINALITIES. Verified this repair round (audit A-1 against director run 38906250297): reports/director/RUN_38906250297.md section 3 asserted, inside the table it heads 'every number recomputed this run from the accepted mount', that 'the 16 absent rows are exactly the 16 UNBACKED, supported=false rows'. Independent recomputation over the accepted artifact results/frontier/frontier-served-packet-falsification/LABEL_HALF.json bundles[*].rows (n=65 = 25 de + 15 fr + 25 it) on (primary_defect_class, counter_evidence_verified, supported) gives ('OFF-DOMAIN', true, false) 38, ('SUPPORTED', true, true) 5, ('UNBACKED', None/absent, false) 16, ('UNBACKED', true, false) 6. So {counter_evidence_verified absent} = 16 while {primary_defect_class = UNBACKED AND supported = false} = 22: the absent set is a PROPER SUBSET, and the sentence also contradicted its own cell (which correctly reports UNBACKED 22). THE CORRECT STATEMENT, which is the correction of record: all 16 absent-verified rows are UNBACKED with supported=false, reason_code 'evidence_absent' and empty cited_evidence, at counter_uncertainty 0.95-1.0 (per bundle de 1 / fr 4 / it 11, the same partition the accepted canvas lock amber 1/4/11 measures); UNBACKED totals 22, and the other 6 carry counter_evidence_verified=true with 52-287 cited quotes and fail for CONTENT reasons instead (reason_code 'no_domain_anchor' 2, 'no_intent_marker' 4; counter_uncertainty 0.25-0.65). WHY IT IS NOT COSMETIC: the 16 are the evidence-plumbing class the accepted render fix addressed; the 6 are evidence-present-but-insufficient and need classifier work. Collapsing them implies every UNBACKED row is a missing-evidence row and hides the distinction on which product's rebuild-or-decline decision turns. STANDING RULE: before writing 'exactly', 'identical to' or 'all of the' between two counted sets of accepted rows, compute the intersection and both differences, never the two counts; a matching sub-count inside a larger count proves containment at best, never identity; and state WHICH field defines each set (bundle, row language, decision id) because per-bundle and per-row language partitions of the same 16 rows differ. PROVENANCE AND SUPERSESSION: RUN_38906250297.md is claim-bearing history and is NOT edited by the director (never overwrite a claim-bearing output; this repair round's declared scope is state/** plus its own report), so that clause is SUPERSEDED as of director run 38915705490 and is NOT claimable. The correction of record is this entry plus reports/director/RUN_38915705490.md sections 2-3, which govern wherever the two reports differ.

THE SERVED PACKET IS UNDER A STANDING ACCEPTED STOP ORDER; ready_for_owner_session=true IS NOT A CLAIM THE PRODUCT MAY MAKE WHILE EITHER FROZEN BAR IS UNMET. Verdict of record: frontier-served-packet-falsification, team run 38880639079, independent audit results/audit/frontier/frontier-served-packet-falsification/CYCLE_38880639079_GATE.json gate=PASS safe_to_integrate=true required_fixes=[], promote commit 464c45f7, product-owned copy results/product/frontier_verdicts/ACCEPTED_frontier-served-packet-falsification_38880639079.json with covers_this_packet=true and serve_recommendation 'DO-NOT-SERVE this packet unchanged'. RECOMPUTED THIS RUN from the accepted measurement artifact LABEL_HALF.json, re-fetched from cycle/frontier/frontier-served-packet-falsification/38877700234/team: 65 scored rows = 25 de + 15 fr + 25 it; 5 supported (0.076923) against the frozen ABSOLUTE bar of 1.0; defect classes OFF-DOMAIN 38, UNBACKED 22, SUPPORTED 5, INVERTED 0. The 22 UNBACKED partition EXACTLY (both differences empty, verified by recomputation, not by matching counts) into 16 rows with counter_evidence_verified absent, reason_code evidence_absent, empty cited_evidence, counter_uncertainty 0.95-1.0, and 6 rows with counter_evidence_verified true carrying 52-287 cited quotes that fail on CONTENT (no_intent_marker 4, no_domain_anchor 2, counter_uncertainty 0.25-0.65). OPERATIVE RULE for every lane, team and report: a packet, owner card, disclosure or status field that carries ready_for_owner_session=true, human_gate_ready=true or 'the next step is the owner session' while either accepted bar is unmet is misstating accepted evidence. Product must consume the two bar verdicts as a machine gate input of packet admission. The owner's attention is the scarcest resource in this factory and must not be spent on a packet an independent audit says must not be served.

A DIRECTION VERSION BUMP CANCELS IN-FLIGHT CORE RUNS, AND THE AUTOMATIC RESUME IS PREFIX-KEYED TO THE NEW VERSION, SO THE BUMPING DIRECTOR MUST NAME THE SNAPSHOT TO CONTINUE FROM OR THE DELTA IS LOST. Verified this run by reading factory-supervisor.yml: cancel_superseded_core_runs cancels every active core-lane run whose displayTitle dirV<N> differs from the current factory_direction.version, while the resume path (latest_operational_failure with prefix "Core <lane> dirV<DIRV> ") only ever matches runs already titled with the NEW version, so a v50 snapshot is never picked up automatically by a v51 dispatch. Consequence of this v51 bump: in-flight Core product dirV50 repair1 run 38988477028 and Core evaluation dirV50 repair0 run 38986445355 are cancelled by the next supervisor tick. ROUTE-AROUND, and the standing rule for every future version bump: each bumped lane's question names the exact snapshot branch to fetch and continue from (here: cycle/core/product/38988477028/team and cycle/core/evaluation/38986445355/team, both confirmed present on origin), and the lane continues from it rather than restarting, so no in-flight delta and no accepted claim-bearing file is dropped.

A MATERIAL FALSE CLAIM INSIDE AN ACCEPTED ARTIFACT IS CORRECTED BY AN AMENDMENT OF RECORD IN THE CONTROL PLANE, NEVER BY RE-DISPATCHING A CHARTER ITS OWN STOP RULE FORBIDS; THE BLOCKED AUDIT THAT FOUND IT IS OPERATIONAL EVIDENCE AND ITS FINDINGS MAY STILL BE TRUE STATEMENTS ABOUT ACCEPTED FILES.
